model_runs.name: dim_customers_dbt
model_runs.compiled_code:
select
    dbt_scd_id,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    customer_tier,
    region,
    dbt_valid_from,
    dbt_valid_to,
    (dbt_valid_to is null) as is_current
from "neondb"."dbt_snapshots"."snap_customers_dbt"

model_runs.name: fct_orders_dbt
model_runs.compiled_code:
select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_date,
    to_char(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') as order_month,
    status,
    (status = 'Completed') as is_completed,
    order_total,
    case when status = 'Completed' then order_total else 0.0 end as realized_revenue,
    cost_total,
    case when status = 'Completed' then (order_total - cost_total) else 0.0 end as gross_profit
from "neondb"."dbt_dev_dbt_silver"."stg_orders"

model_runs.name: stg_customers
model_runs.compiled_code:
select
    cast(customer_id as integer) as customer_id,
    trim(customer_name) as customer_name,
    trim(customer_tier) as customer_tier,
    trim(region) as region,
    cast(updated_at as date) as updated_at
from "neondb"."raw"."raw_customers"

model_runs.name: stg_orders
model_runs.compiled_code:
select
    cast(order_id as integer) as order_id,
    cast(customer_id as integer) as customer_id,
    cast(order_date as date) as order_date,
    trim(status) as status,
    cast(order_total as double precision) as order_total,
    cast(cost_total as double precision) as cost_total
from "neondb"."raw"."raw_orders"
